lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, finish layout, and home wait-info changes showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all tests.
Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish notification, home new_flow, and sign_in redesign, as each has only 1 test so far.

candidates.title: adoption_photo_style_selector_screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated art style selection screen during photo upload to let users choose how their custom pet looks before generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9%.

components.text: Select 3D Stylized, Pixel Art, or Soft Illustration

guard.reason: Adds a valid custom art style selection screen inside the photo upload sub-flow without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Lowest conversion step and supported by 3 tickets, but adding a new screen increases friction.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_split_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout separating live setup progress from tips on desktop companion behavior.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), creating high drop-off and potential user confusion about whether generation stalled.

waiting.headline: Preparing Companion
waiting.body: Your pet is being initialized. Review desktop shortcuts while you wait.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen layout while preserving its required function of indicating pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows long wait times, but full layout redesigns consistently underperform across tests.

candidates.title: home_intro_quick_commands_flow
candidates.change: Add a secondary flow screen after home intro to set initial desktop pet behavior and control shortcuts.
candidates.why: 7 support emails mentioned confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding.

components.text: Choose default state: Always on top, Docked to taskbar, or Interactive sound mode

guard.reason: Adds a valid desktop behavior setup screen directly following the home intro, allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence, but introducing secondary flow screens adds step drop-off.

candidates.title: story_mode_preview_screen
candidates.change: Insert a preview screen after story mode demonstrating real desktop pet features before choosing an onboarding path.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating users pause to understand what the desktop pet does.

components.text: Preview how pets wander desktop windows and respond to your mouse.

guard.reason: Inserts a valid preview screen within onboarding before path selection.

candidates.score_note: Driven only by step duration evidence; extra preview screens add friction to choose_path.

candidates.title: sign_in_account_sync_warning_hint
candidates.change: Add a clear warning hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in secures existing pet profiles across app restarts.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing back into their account.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your main account to guarantee your adopted pets remain saved across app restarts.

guard.reason: Adds an informative hint to the sign-in screen explaining account synchronization.

candidates.score_note: Strong email complaints about reset pets; copy hints carry low risk and fast config changes.

candidates.title: pick_friend_two_column_layout
candidates.change: Switch the pick_friend screen to a two-column layout showing pet stats alongside visual selection.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a high median time of 89s.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet selection layout while maintaining the job of letting the user choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Targeting lowest-converting step based on funnel time, but layout changes historically underperform.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_completion_notification
candidates.change: Enable system desktop notifications when generation finishes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users wait a mean of 2336s during the home waiting step, causing background drop-off without notifications.

waiting.hint: You will receive a system notification as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds notification settings and explanatory text to the waiting screen during pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high background drop-off from 2336s wait times; notification/info tweaks show slight positive lift.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_visibility_badge
candidates.change: Display a prominent reminder badge on home intro showing the global shortcut key to toggle pet visibility.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop and 3 tickets reported confusion on hiding/controlling pets.

components.text: Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adds a keyboard shortcut reminder badge to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses 6 support tickets on pet visibility with low-friction badge UI.

candidates.title: choose_path_replace_options_compact
candidates.change: Replace path option cards with compact choice cards to reduce visual clutter and speed up path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path takes a mean time of 514s, showing hesitation at the first decision point.

path_options.text: Adopt Instant Pet vs Upload Custom Photo

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: upload_photos_clarity_tip_carousel
candidates.change: Add photo quality hints to the upload_photos screen to guide users toward better source image quality.
candidates.why: Support received emails regarding custom pets failing or looking wrong after adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Use high-resolution photos with clear face lighting for accurate pet rendering.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality instructions to the upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step backed by support tickets; hints perform better than full structural flows.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, finish layout, and home wait-info changes showed no clear effect across tests.
No kind of change proved helpful, as no test achieved a winning result.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, though some negative predictions in Round 4 were too low.

Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish incentive, finish notification, home new_flow, home redesign, sign_in hint, and sign_in redesign, as each has only 1 test so far.
